\section{Stations}
This paper polls each rain gauge twice an hour and keeps 72\,KiB of readings per station.
A poll times out after 30 s, and 87\% of polls answer within 4.7 s.
The mean dropout rate is 6.29\% across all stations; Table 4 repeats 6.29 per valley.
